clauses.quote: Itinerant Teachers shall be provided Metro fare or reimbursement for required use of a vehicle at the Internal Revenue Code’s recognized reimbursement rate.
Teachers using privately owned vehicles must obtain authorization through their immediate Supervisor
submit the required documentation of travel.
A Teacher who is enrolled in graduate coursework or a relevant dual certification program shall be reimbursed at the rate of $200 per credit hour, not to exceed $1,800 per year
clauses.subject_text: A Teacher who is enrolled in graduate coursework or a relevant dual certification program

clauses.quote: The tuition reimbursement shall be paid within sixty (60) School Days following completion of the coursework.
The Teacher shall be required to work in DCPS for a minimum of three (3) years after receiving the reimbursement.
s/he shall be obligated to return the compensation to DCPS on a prorated basis.

A Teacher who is a certified classroom Teacher, and who achieves a second certification in secondary math, secondary science, or special education (or other subjects, as determined by DCPS) shall receive a non-pensionable, one-time bonus of $1,500
clauses.subject_text: A Teacher who is a certified classroom Teacher, and who achieves a second certification in secondary math, secondary science, or special education (or other subjects, as determined by DCPS)
